content.text:
Fixed. The glyph only spanned `180.5 → 535.17` inside a `0 0 716 716` viewBox — roughly 50% padding on every side — so the `center / contain` mask painter drew it at about half the size of every other icon.

- [openai.svg](plugins/pantoken/custom-icons/assets/icons/openai.svg) now uses `viewBox="180.5 180.5 354.68 354.68"`, the glyph's own bounds (I sampled the bezier curves rather than trusting the control-point extents). Dropped the redundant `width`/`height` attributes and moved `fill="currentColor"` onto the path, matching the other icons in that directory.
- Re-ran `vp run generate`, so `generated/icons/openai.css`, the barrel, and `embedded.ts` carry the new data URI. Tests pass (17/17).
- Added [openai-icon-tight-viewbox.md](.changeset/openai-icon-tight-viewbox.md).

The `dist/` copies are stale until the next pack; they're build output, so I left them alone.
